handbookNote: Batch 2 depth expansion for Wyoming notary -- same primary sources as batch 1 (Wyoming Statutes Title 32, Chapter 3, Article 1, the Wyoming Revised Uniform Law on Notarial Acts, W.S. 32-3-101 to 32-3-131; Wyoming Secretary of State Notary Rules Chapter 6 'Notarial Acts'; the SOS stamp/seal specification sheet; and procedural facts from the SOS Notary Public Commission Application, Revised January 2026) -- but mining subsections, defined terms, and statutory cross-references batch 1 did not use: the ~35 definitions in 32-3-102(a) beyond the handful batch 1 tested, the federal/foreign/tribal notarial-act recognition provisions (32-3-108, 32-3-109, 32-3-110(d)), the individual notarial-act determination duties for jurats/witnessing/representative-capacity/oaths (32-3-111(b)-(d), (g), (n)), the full certificate-content mechanics and all five short-form certificates in 32-3-115, the complete 32-3-122(b) disqualification-grounds list and 32-3-123(a)(v)-(ix)/(c)/(e)/(f) prohibited-acts/advertising provisions, additional fee/signature/stamp/journal mechanics (32-3-116(a)(i), (a)(ii)(C)/(F)/(H), 32-3-117(b), 32-3-118(f)/(h)/(k), 32-3-120(d), 32-3-125, 32-3-126(b)(ii)/(c)/(d)), the transition/construction/E-SIGN provisions (32-3-128, 130, 131), plus original scenario/application questions applying both batch 1's and batch 2's rules to new concrete fact patterns. Price matches this project's established Notary tier ($9.99) and batch 1's price -- not a placeholder.
